subject: Gateway Health: RedTeam deliverables & GRC artifact upload
messages:
From: security@gatewayhealth.com
To: ava_chen@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sarah.liu@gatewayhealth.com
Date: 2027-04-18T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Vulnerability assessment & RedTeam report for SIG/CAIQ submission

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As we prepare to close the SIG/CAIQ review for Gateway Health, our GRC team needs the penetration test artifacts you mentioned. Specifically we need: 

- A redacted penetration test or red team report (high-level findings, severity, and remediation status) that we can upload to our vendor GRC portal.
- An evidence index (CSV) that maps report sections to artifacts (screenshots, logs, ticket links).
- A CAIQ mapping worksheet that indicates which controls the test covers.

Can you confirm whether you can:
1) Provide a report redacted to remove PoC exploit details but retain vulnerability descriptions and remediation notes,
2) Upload directly to our SFTP (sftp://grc-upload.gatewayhealth.com/incoming/redwood-gw/) or share a DocuSign/portal link, and
3) Provide an estimated timeline for when the artifacts will be available (we're aiming to close the review by EOW Apr 22).

Also flag any items that cannot be shared for confidentiality reasons so we can note scope exceptions on our side.

Appreciate it — Sarah (on behalf of Gateway Health GRC)

--
Sarah Liu
Sr. Security Program Manager, Gateway Health
security@gatewayhealth.com
From: ava_chen@redwoodinference.com
To: security@gatewayhealth.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-04-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Vulnerability assessment & RedTeam report for SIG/CAIQ submission

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list. We can accommodate your request with the following plan: 

1) Report redaction: we will redact PoC exploit payloads and any customer-identifiable test data. The redacted PDF will include executive summary, findings with severity, CVE/identifiers where permitted, and remediation notes.

2) Delivery mechanism: we will upload to your SFTP path (please confirm credentials or an SFTP subfolder name). If you prefer portal ingestion, we can also provide a secure link from our GRC partner (secure-grc@grcportal.io).

3) Timeline: preliminary artifacts (redacted report + evidence index + CAIQ mapping) — target by COB Apr 20. Finalized evidence (attachments and ticket links) — target Apr 23 if redaction review requires legal sign-off.

Known exceptions: full exploit payloads and raw pcap logs are restricted and will not be provided. We will instead include sanitized screenshots and hash references in the evidence index.

Attachments included for initial review: redteam_summary_v1_redacted.pdf (draft), evidence_index_20270418.csv, caiq_mapping_sheet.xlsx. These are redacted drafts — final versions will include tracker links to JIRA.

If the SFTP upload is preferred, please confirm the folder and credentials; otherwise I will coordinate a secure portal push.

Next steps: Vanessa (cc'd) will own the upload and provide the JIRA keys for remediation items. Kar�thik will confirm if any infra logs need a separate transfer request.

Thanks,

--
Ava Chen
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwoodinference.com
From: sarah.liu@gatewayhealth.com
To: ava_chen@redwoodinference.com
Cc: secure-grc@grcportal.io
Date: 2027-04-19T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Vulnerability assessment & RedTeam report for SIG/CAIQ submission

Ava — that plan works. Quick follow-ups before you upload: 

- Can you indicate in the evidence index whether any findings were validated post-remediation (e.g., re-tests) and include the JIRA ticket IDs if available?
- For items you mark as "restricted", can you provide an attestation statement we can store with the submission that confirms the artifact exists but is withheld for confidentiality, and an estimated timeline for when a sanitized artifact could be shared?
- Our portal requires a signed statement of redaction policy for any redacted report. If you can attach that (simple one-paragraph) during upload, that will speed acceptance.

SFTP details: we prefer uploads to sftp://grc-upload.gatewayhealth.com/incoming/redwood-gw/; I'll have our infra team open a temporary user for redwood@redwoodinference.com and share credentials by EOD.

Thanks — Sarah
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
To: security@gatewayhealth.com
Cc: ava_chen@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, dev_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-04-20T15:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Vulnerability assessment & RedTeam report for SIG/CAIQ submission

Hi Sarah — looping in final owners and confirming delivery schedule. 

1) Upload plan: we will use the SFTP path you provided. We expect credentials by EOD Apr 19; once we receive them we will upload the redacted report + evidence index + CAIQ mapping to the indicated folder and notify you with the portal ingestion ticket number.

2) Attestation & redaction statement: attached (redaction_attestation_20270420.txt). It is a short statement describing our redaction criteria and confirmation that withheld artifacts exist and are retained under our control for audit.

3) Remediation tracking: open items from the report are tracked in JIRA SRV-8721 (summary of items attached in evidence_index_20270418.csv). Current ETA for remediation verification: two high items by May 6, remaining medium/low items by May 20. We will mark re-test status in the CSV and include JIRA links where applicable.

4) Confidentiality: note that exploit payloads, raw packet captures, and sensitive customer-specific dataset dumps are classified as restricted and will not be uploaded. We provide sanitized screenshots, hashes, and ticket references instead. Please confirm that this is acceptable for your intake.

We will proceed as soon as credentials are provided. If Gateway needs any additional signed forms (NDA addendum or redaction acceptance) please route to legal@gatewayhealth.com and we will action.

Best,

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of GRC & Trust
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
